profile_revalidation.reason: Profile 0.16 filesystem effects are now used by the versioned publication contract; Profile 0.18 is the family compatibility ceiling, not a claim that every frozen module needs 0.18 semantics.

pressure_reclassification.note: Profile 0.16 now expresses create/write/rename/sync; runtime effect wiring and directory durability remain host-bound.

Store now has a retained mncs-embed semantic driver and the focused typed-substrate path reuses one session across batches; the ordinary legacy lifecycle/reference matrix remains CLI-backed until the broader cutover is proven.
Reclamation scan cost remains an explicit scheduled obligation, not an ordinary per-change suite.
